name: Skywork
description:
Here is how to read the Skywork config.json. The architecture class is SkyworkForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,608: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 65,519 × 4,608: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 36, so each head sees 128 dimensions (4,608 / 36). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 4608 / 36 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 36, so this is multi-head attention (MHA): every query head keeps its own key/value.

num_hidden_layers is 52: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 12,288. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 4,608-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 4,096 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is.

vocab_size is 65,519. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is bfloat16. Brain floating point keeps FP32’s exponent range with less mantissa, which avoids the overflow/underflow of a tiny exponent at the cost of noisier decimals — and it halves the on-chip footprint versus FP32. NVIDIA A100s were the first NVIDIA chips with native BF16; Huawei Ascend 910-class parts also prefer BF16/FP16 on the cube.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/Skywork/Skywork-13B-Base/blob/main/config.json.
